title: Review platform purpose and veteran-first standards
description: Understand the mission of Veteran Benefits Assistance, the tone we use, and the standard of care expected when working with Veterans.

title: Understand VA compliance rules and ethical boundaries
description: Learn what employees can and cannot do (no legal advice, no outcome guarantees, handle documents responsibly, fees explained correctly).

title: Learn how to navigate dashboards, clients, and case records
description: Learn where client records live, how to open a case, how to review notes, uploads, and service selections.

title: Upload, review, and manage evidence correctly
description: Learn how to upload files, label them properly, categorize them, and avoid duplicates or missing key documents.

title: Use AI guidance without overriding professional judgment
description: Understand how AI suggestions are used (support tool only), how to verify accuracy, and when to escalate to Director.

title: Generate correct VA forms and understand when each is required
description: Learn how the forms generator works, where forms are stored, and how to avoid generating unnecessary or incorrect forms.

title: Prepare, review, and finalize service agreements and contracts
description: Learn how service agreements work, how pricing is displayed, when percent-based fees apply, and how to store signed docs.

title: Communicate with clients through internal messaging
description: Learn how to send and receive messages, use templates, document conversations, and avoid sharing sensitive info improperly.

title: Handle life-event changes and update benefits accordingly
description: Learn what dependency changes are (marriage, children, school status) and where to document changes for client follow-up.

title: Resolve common issues without escalation
description: Learn standard fixes for common problems (missing files, unclear timelines, duplicate records, incomplete intake).

title: Know when and how to escalate critical cases
description: Learn escalation rules (urgent hardship, deadlines, safety concerns, legal representation questions, hostile communications).

title: Confirm understanding of data security and confidentiality
description: Learn how we store documents, what is allowed, what is prohibited, and how to handle sensitive personal information safely.
